items.title: File Widerspruch against the Änderungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 15.10.2025, sent by an authority under social law (Jobcenter, SGB X applies). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after the date on the letter (2025-10-15 + 4 days = Sun 19.10.2025); this day does not shift for weekends under social-law delivery rules. Counting the one-month objection period per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X starts the day after delivery (20.10.2025); per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends one month later on the day matching the delivery date's number, i.e. Wed 19.11.2025. That day is Buß- und Bettag, a Sachsen public holiday, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline moves to the next business day, Thu 20.11.2025.
